Text Field:
Purpose: Single-line input for short values; Type Dropdown picks one value from 7 or more options.
Usage rules: Filled for text entry in forms. Outlined where a form sits on a busy surface. Dropdown to pick one value from 7 or more options. Not for long, multi-line text (use Text Area). Not for searching the library or catalog (use Search Bar). Not for 2 to 6 visible choices (use Radio).
Accessibility: Label and value: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. Container border / indicator: 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11) in Light, Dark. Keep a persistent label; never use the placeholder as the only label. Error state shows a text message, not only the red color. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Behavior: Focused shows the 2 dp active indicator in primary. Error replaces the supporting text with the error message.
Keywords: input, text field, form, dropdown, select
Text Area:
Purpose: Multi-line text input for comments, descriptions and notes.
Usage rules: Free text longer than one line, such as a playlist description or feedback. Not for short single values like a name or email (use Text Field).
Accessibility: Text: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. Container border: 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11) in Light, Dark. Pair it with a visible label above it. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Keywords: textarea, multi-line, comment, description
Checkbox:
Purpose: Independent on/off choice in a list of options, or a single consent.
Usage rules: Selecting several items at once. One consent or opt-in line. Not for settings that apply immediately (use Switch). Not for exactly one choice from a list (use Radio).
Accessibility: Box border and check: 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11) in Light, Dark. Label the whole row, not only the box. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Behavior: Error state marks a required choice that is missing.
Keywords: checkbox, multi-select, consent
Switch:
Purpose: Turns one setting on or off immediately, such as AI Mix in the player.
Usage rules: A binary setting that applies at once, without a Save button. Not for choices that need a confirm step (use Checkbox). Not for picking one of several options (use Radio or Filter Chip).
Accessibility: Track and handle: 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11) in Light, Dark. Announce the setting name and its on/off state. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Keywords: switch, toggle, on off, setting
Radio:
Purpose: Single choice from 2 to 6 visible options.
Usage rules: 2 to 6 mutually exclusive options that should all stay visible. Not for 7 or more options (use Text Field with Type Dropdown). Not for several answers allowed (use Checkbox).
Accessibility: Ring and dot: 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11) in Light, Dark. Group the options under one visible question. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Keywords: radio, single choice, option
Button:
Purpose: Starts an action; Style sets the emphasis.
Usage rules: Filled for the one main action of a screen. Tonal for secondary actions. Outlined for alternatives such as New playlist. Text for low-emphasis actions in dialogs. Neutral (gray pill) for More in section headers. Outlined Accent (tertiary purple) for a featured discovery action such as Radar songs around you. Not for icon-only actions (use Icon Button). Not for filtering content (use Filter Chip). Not for moving between top-level destinations (use Bottom Navigation).
Accessibility: Label: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. Outlined border: 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11) in Light, Dark. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Behavior: Show Leading Icon turns the icon on; pick it with the Leading Icon swap. Disabled uses on_surface at 38% for the label.
Keywords: button, action, cta
Icon Button:
Purpose: Compact action shown as an icon only, such as Like, Share, More or Play.
Usage rules: Standard for toolbar and row actions (more_vert, favorite). Tonal for secondary actions such as Share on the player. Inverse for the main Play action. Filled for a strong single action on media. Not for actions that need a text label to be understood (use Button).
Accessibility: Icon on its container: 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11) in Light, Dark. Give every instance an accessible name (Like, Share, Play). Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Behavior: Swap play_arrow to pause while playing. The icon fills the container minus its padding: resize the instance and set its padding to size the glyph (Play 64 dp with spacing/8 padding, Mini Player Play 40 dp with spacing/4).
Keywords: icon button, action, play, like, more
Filter Chip:
Purpose: Filters content in place, such as All / Arabic / International / Podcasts on Explore.
Usage rules: 2 to 6 visible filters above a feed or list. Switching Playlists / Albums / Artists in the Library. Not for 7 or more filters (use Text Field with Type Dropdown). Not for starting an action (use Button).
Accessibility: Label: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. Announce the selected state. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Keywords: chip, filter, segment
Tab Item:
Purpose: One tab label inside Primary Tabs.
Usage rules: Inside Primary Tabs only, for Music / Podcasts style switching. Not for on its own (use Primary Tabs). Not for filtering a list (use Filter Chip).
Accessibility: Label: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. Selected tab is announced as selected. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Keywords: tab, segment
Navigation Item:
Purpose: One destination inside Bottom Navigation: icon plus label.
Usage rules: Inside Bottom Navigation only. Not for actions on the current screen (use Icon Button).
Accessibility: Label: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. Selected item is announced as selected. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Keywords: navigation, tab bar, destination
Primary Tabs:
Purpose: Two large condensed tabs that switch the Library between Music and Podcasts.
Usage rules: Top-level content switch inside one destination. Not for moving between app destinations (use Bottom Navigation). Not for more than 2 small filters (use Filter Chip).
Accessibility: Tabs are a tab list; the selected tab is announced. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Keywords: tabs, music, podcasts
Bottom Navigation:
Purpose: App navigation bar with the four destinations Explore, Search, Connect and Your Library.
Usage rules: Bottom of every top-level screen on compact windows. Not for actions on the current screen. Not for fewer than 3 destinations.
Accessibility: Each item has a visible label. Selected destination is announced. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Keywords: bottom navigation, navigation bar, tab bar
Search Bar:
Purpose: Entry point to search the library or catalog, with an optional voice search mic.
Usage rules: Top of Library and Search screens. Not for form fields (use Text Field).
Accessibility: Placeholder: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. Mic has its own accessible name (Voice search). Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Keywords: search, find, voice
Top App Bar:
Purpose: Screen header with a condensed title and the Notifications, Community and Profile actions.
Usage rules: Top of top-level screens such as Explore. Show Actions off for screens with a title only, such as Search & Discover. Not for the full player (use Playlist App Bar).
Accessibility: Title: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. Every action has an accessible name. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Keywords: app bar, header, top bar
Playlist App Bar:
Purpose: Header of the full player: collapse, the playing source and the AI Mix switch.
Usage rules: Top of the Now Playing and Lyrics screens. Not for top-level screens (use Top App Bar).
Accessibility: Title and AI Mix label: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. Collapse is announced as Close player. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Keywords: player header, now playing, ai mix
Status Bar:
Purpose: Android system status bar used in screen mockups (time, Wi-Fi, signal, battery).
Usage rules: First full-bleed row of every 375 dp screen. Not for app actions or content.
Accessibility: Decorative system chrome, not interactive. Time: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark.
Keywords: status bar, system, mockup
Mini Player:
Purpose: Persistent bar above Bottom Navigation showing the playing track with Like and Play.
Usage rules: Every top-level screen while something is playing. Not for inside the full player.
Accessibility: Title and artist: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. Tapping the bar opens Now Playing; Like and Play are separate targets. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Keywords: mini player, now playing, playback
Playback Progress:
Purpose: Track position bar with elapsed and total time.
Usage rules: Full player, under the track title. Not for loading states (use Progress Indicator alone).
Accessibility: Times: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. Announce position as elapsed of total; seeking needs a 48 dp tall hit area. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Keywords: progress, seek, scrubber, timeline
Playback Controls:
Purpose: Main player controls: Like, Previous, Play/Pause, Next and Download.
Usage rules: Full player (Now Playing and Lyrics). Not for compact contexts (use Mini Player).
Accessibility: Every control has an accessible name; Play switches to Pause. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Keywords: player, controls, play, pause, next
Player Utility Bar:
Purpose: Bottom row of the full player opening Lyrics, Queue and Audio settings.
Usage rules: Bottom of the Now Playing and Lyrics screens. Not for primary playback actions (use Playback Controls).
Accessibility: Labels: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Behavior: Active marks the open view with an inverse pill (Lyrics on the Lyrics screen); None on Now Playing.
Keywords: lyrics, queue, audio, player
Artwork:
Purpose: Square cover image for a song, album, playlist or podcast.
Usage rules: Inside cards, list items and players. Not for people (use Avatar).
Accessibility: Decorative when the title is next to it; otherwise give alt text with the title.
Keywords: artwork, cover, album art, image
Avatar:
Purpose: Round picture of the signed-in user or an artist.
Usage rules: Profile entry in Top App Bar. Artist rows. Not for album or playlist covers (use Artwork).
Accessibility: Accessible name is the person name or Profile. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Keywords: avatar, profile, user
Tooltip:
Purpose: Short help text on long press or focus; Rich adds a title and longer text.
Usage rules: Explaining an icon-only control. Not for essential instructions or errors (show them on screen).
Accessibility: Text: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. Also reachable by keyboard focus.
Keywords: tooltip, help, hint
Badge:
Purpose: Small label on artwork or an avatar: Plan shows the subscription plan, Explicit marks explicit content.
Usage rules: Type Plan: plan label (plus) on the profile avatar. Type Explicit: the "E" marker on explicit songs and albums. Not for long text or actions.
Accessibility: Label: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. Include the meaning in the parent accessible name (Explicit).
Keywords: badge, explicit, label
Section Header:
Purpose: Title of a content rail with optional supporting text and a More button.
Usage rules: Above every horizontal rail on Explore. Not for above sortable lists (use List Header).
Accessibility: Title: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. Title is a heading for screen readers. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Keywords: section, header, rail title
Shortcut Card:
Purpose: Compact card with artwork and label for quick access, such as Music Mix or Recently Played.
Usage rules: Two-column shortcut grid at the top of Explore. Not for category tiles without artwork (use Library Shortcut Tile).
Accessibility: Label: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. The whole card is one target. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Keywords: shortcut, card, quick access
Media Carousel:
Purpose: Horizontal rail of Media Cards that scrolls and clips at the screen edge.
Usage rules: Explore rails such as Your new music and For You. Not for vertical lists (use Playlist List Item).
Accessibility: Cards stay reachable in reading order; the rail scrolls with the screen reader.
Keywords: carousel, rail, horizontal list
Library Shortcut Tile:
Purpose: Category tile with a colored icon and label, such as Likes, Downloads or Saved.
Usage rules: 3 or 4 equal-width tiles in a row at the top of the Library. Not for media with artwork (use Shortcut Card).
Accessibility: Label: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. Icon: 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11) in Light, Dark. Whole tile is the target, at least 80 x 80 dp. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Keywords: library, shortcut, category, tile
Media Card:
Purpose: One item in a media rail: artwork with title and subtitle, or a mix with a description.
Usage rules: Size Default for songs, albums and artists. Size Large for mixes such as Your Weekly Mixtape. Not for vertical lists (use Playlist List Item).
Accessibility: Title and subtitle: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. The card is one target; title is its accessible name. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Keywords: media card, song, album, mix
Track Metadata:
Purpose: Title and subtitle of a track or playlist, with an optional downloaded icon.
Usage rules: Inside Mini Player, Media Card and list items. Not for section titles (use Section Header).
Accessibility: Title and subtitle: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. Truncated text stays fully readable by the screen reader.
Keywords: metadata, title, artist, subtitle
Playlist List Item:
Purpose: Row for a playlist, album or artist with artwork, metadata and a More action.
Usage rules: Library lists of playlists, albums and artists. Not for podcast episodes (use Podcast Episode Card).
Accessibility: Title and subtitle: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. The row and More are separate targets. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Keywords: list item, playlist, row
Podcast Episode Card:
Purpose: Episode card with artwork, title, description, listened progress, Download and More.
Usage rules: Continue playing and episode lists in Podcasts. Not for music playlists (use Playlist List Item).
Accessibility: Texts: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. Progress is announced as time left. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Keywords: podcast, episode, card
List Header:
Purpose: Header above a sortable list with a sort control and an optional main action.
Usage rules: Above Playlists in the Library, with New playlist. Not for above content rails (use Section Header).
Accessibility: Title: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. Sort control announces the current sort. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Keywords: list header, sort, new playlist
Dialog:
Purpose: Modal window for a focused decision that blocks the screen until answered.
Usage rules: Basic for confirmations. List to pick from a short list. Not for non-blocking messages. Not for supplemental tasks (use Sheet).
Accessibility: Title and body: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. Focus moves into the dialog and returns on close. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Keywords: dialog, modal, confirm
Sheet:
Purpose: Bottom or side surface for supplemental tasks such as the queue or a track menu.
Usage rules: Bottom on phones for menus and details. Side on large screens. Not for blocking confirmations (use Dialog).
Accessibility: Title: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. Has a visible close or drag handle and closes with Back.
Keywords: sheet, bottom sheet, menu
Progress Indicator:
Purpose: Linear bar showing determinate progress, such as the listened part of an episode.
Usage rules: Episode progress. Inside Playback Progress. Not for seeking on its own (use Playback Progress).
Accessibility: Active track: 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11) in Light, Dark. Announce the value as a percentage or time.
Behavior: Value sets the active track as a percent; the active track scales with the instance width.
Keywords: progress, linear, loading
Divider:
Purpose: Thin line that separates groups of content.
Usage rules: Between groups that spacing alone does not separate. Not for between every list row (use spacing).
Accessibility: Decorative; hidden from screen readers.
Keywords: divider, separator, line
Lyrics Line:
Purpose: One line of synced lyrics; State shows where playback is.
Usage rules: Lyrics screen, one instance per line. Align End for right-to-left lines (Arabic), Start for left-to-right. Not for body text or descriptions (use the text styles).
Accessibility: Current line: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. Past and Upcoming lines are dimmed on purpose; the screen reader reads every line. Respect the system font size; lines wrap.
Behavior: Current is on_surface; Past and Upcoming are outline (dimmed).
Keywords: lyrics, line, karaoke, synced
Lyrics Header:
Purpose: Track header at the top of the Lyrics screen: artwork, title, artist, Share and More.
Usage rules: Top of the Lyrics screen, under the collapse button. Not for now Playing (artwork is large there). Not for lists (use Playlist List Item).
Accessibility: Title and artist: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. Share and More have accessible names. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Keywords: lyrics, header, track
Genre Card:
Purpose: Tile that opens a genre, mood or chart: artist photo on a category color with the genre name.
Usage rules: Search & Discover grids (Popular, Moods & Genres), two per row. Color picks the category accent; neighbours use different colors. Not for library shortcuts with an icon (use Library Shortcut Tile). Not for songs or albums (use Media Card).
Accessibility: Label on the category color: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3) in Light, Dark. The whole card is one target; the label is its accessible name. Touch target: 48 x 48 dp (WCAG 2.5.8). Visual size may be smaller; the hit area stays 48 dp.
Keywords: genre, mood, category, browse, search
